block.connectedstorage.item_pipe.tooltip: Carries an _Item Pump_'s link to _Item Vaults_ and _Item Silos_. A pump reaches _1 pipe block per 16 RPM_, up to 16.
When part of a pumped network
Every storage the pipes and pumps reach shares _one inventory_. Pipes beyond a pump's reach, or without a running pump, do nothing.
block.connectedstorage.item_pump.tooltip: Merges the _Item Vaults_ and _Item Silos_ connected to it into _one shared inventory_. Connects on both ends, directly to storages or through _Item Pipes_.
Reaches _1 pipe block per 16 RPM_, up to _16 at 256 RPM_. Funnels, chutes and packagers on _any_ reached storage can reach _every_ reached storage. Use another pump to go further.
The storages split apart again. Items stay where they are.
connectedstorage.ponder.item_pump.text_1: Item Vaults and Item Silos normally keep their items to themselves
connectedstorage.ponder.item_pump.text_2: An Item Pump links the storages on both of its ends into one shared inventory
connectedstorage.ponder.item_pump.text_3: It needs rotation: drive it with a cogwheel at 16 RPM or faster
connectedstorage.ponder.item_pump.text_4: Funnels, chutes and packagers on either storage can now reach the items in both
connectedstorage.ponder.item_pump.text_5: Item Pipes carry the link further. A pump reaches 1 pipe block for every 16 RPM, up to 16 blocks
connectedstorage.ponder.item_pump.text_6: At 32 RPM it only reaches 2 pipe blocks, so the far vault is left out
connectedstorage.ponder.item_pump.text_7: Speed it up, or add another running Item Pump along the line, to reach further
